title: ML goodput product
caption: Useful fleet output as a share of held capacity: scheduling, runtime and program goodput multiply.

symbols.name: ML productivity goodput
symbols.meaning: share of held fleet capacity that became training progress

symbols.name: scheduling goodput
symbols.meaning: share of fleet capacity held by complete allocations

symbols.name: runtime goodput
symbols.meaning: share of allocated time producing checkpoint-retained steps at fault-free rate

symbols.name: program goodput
symbols.meaning: retained step rate against a named hardware ideal; equals MFU

title: Loss-share decomposition
caption: Every lost device-hour is charged at exactly one boundary, in chronological order: scheduling first, then runtime, then program.

symbols.name: scheduling loss share
symbols.meaning: capacity never held by a complete allocation

symbols.name: runtime loss share
symbols.meaning: allocated time not producing retained steps, in units that survived scheduling

symbols.name: program loss share
symbols.meaning: retained-step deficit below the hardware ideal, in units that survived both prior boundaries

title: Program goodput as MFU
caption: Program goodput pins the business number to a hardware number: useful model FLOPs per device per step, divided by distributed step time, against a named peak.

symbols.name: useful model FLOPs
symbols.meaning: model FLOPs one step mathematically requires, no recomputation or padding

symbols.name: peak rate
symbols.meaning: the named hardware ideal, dense or sparse — the choice is part of the measurement

symbols.name: step time
symbols.meaning: distributed wall-clock time per training step

title: Runtime loss composition
caption: Five additive terms, five owners: startup, data stalls, checkpoint waste, failure recovery and preemption tax.

symbols.name: startup share
symbols.meaning: fixed job-start cost amortized over allocated wall time

symbols.name: data stall fraction
symbols.meaning: share of step time devices wait on input

symbols.name: checkpoint waste fraction
symbols.meaning: write cost plus discarded work since last checkpoint

symbols.name: failure term
symbols.meaning: recovery time per mean time between failures

title: Arithmetic intensity
caption: The roofline's x-axis. Batch-one decode on the 70B replica sits near 1.8 FLOPs per byte, far below any modern accelerator's ridge point.

symbols.name: arithmetic intensity
symbols.meaning: FLOPs per byte of memory traffic; fixes whether compute or bandwidth bounds the kernel

symbols.name: memory traffic
symbols.meaning: bytes read and written to HBM, including every weight at batch one
